description: prop:alpha-em-categorical-trace-ratio proves alpha_EM = h^2/(q*delta_q(T_2,9)*delta_q(T_3,5)) = 1/(q [9]_q [10]_q) -- an exact algebraic identity, verified here to 1e-53 at every registered pin, since delta_q(T_2,9) = h[9]_q and delta_q(T_3,5) = h[10]_q cancel the h^2. It cites prop:em-coupling-projection for the right-hand side. That block publishes the right side at the PROTON pin and says so; this block publishes the left side at a MUON pin, so the two sides of a proved identity are published as numbers differing by 7.94e-8 relative. Determined by rounding test against every registered q0: the proton pin fails all four of the block's table figures (residuals 1.0e-7 to 1.5e-7) and every muon variant reproduces all four exactly. The VINTAGE is undeterminable -- the three muon variants differ by 7.98e-11 relative, the sharpest published figure carries 9 significant digits, and separating them needs about 12; all three round correctly on all four, and this probe does not guess. Explains why the candidate-producer sweep found no witness covering more than 1 of these 4 figures among 3277: the cited witness declares a different block and is proton-anchored, so the live compute for this quantity sits at the other pin. qou-i229.
caveats: Determines the anchor FAMILY (muon, decisively) and says NOTHING about which muon vintage. The published precision cannot separate them and no guess is recorded here -- qou-i229 has twice recorded that 'no resolving power' and 'clean' look identical in a results table.

Says nothing about which pin either block SHOULD use; that is the owner ruling qou-i229 holds. It is sharper here than elsewhere only because the two blocks publish the two sides of one identity and so cannot both be right.
Says nothing about whether the bare form models alpha_EM at all. rem:em-coupling-chern-simons is explicitly open. No published figure is changed.
q0AnchorReason: comparison by design: rounding test of both blocks' figures against every registered pin (proton, live CODATA-2022 muon, retired CODATA-2018 muon, frozen pin A 1.1099785955573347)
